TIPS : - Avoid dandruff or harsh shampoos. These can strip colour like there is no tomorrow! - Use a sulphate free or color friendly shampoo & wash as little as possible. Colour will be lost after each wash so avoid over-washing! - Rinse hair with cold water, post shampooing. It closes the hair cuticles and seals in maximum colour. - Too much direct sunlight will strip all that edgy Crazy Color right out. - Avoid swimming. Chlorine is another nasty product that will strip the life and color from your lovely hair. Please Note: We recommend that you patch test any new product before its continued usage. If any redness or itching occurs do not continue use.  CRAZY COLOR
